column1: # Kegare, a demon from another age who has taken Mia's visage.

column3: I have watched you\nprotect Mia.\nNow I understand{page_break}why she trusts you.{end_wait}
You have Mia's face.\nWho are you?{end_wait}

I am Kegare.
I come from an age
long buried.{page_break}I learned her voice.
I studied her face.
Now I will take her place.{end_wait}
You are not Mia.\nAnd you never will be.{end_wait}
You wear my face.\nYou know nothing\nof the life I've lived.{end_wait}
When I am done,\nthey will call me Mia.\nAnd forget you.{end_wait}
My face is not my life.\nMy choices made me.\nYou cannot steal them.{end_wait}
